description: Kernel-map probe: which Excel distribution functions are bit-identical compositions of a shared kernel? Each row: inputs in A..C, E = the function, F and G (and I) = candidate identities, H = family label. Families: chisq (vs GAMMA.DIST), gscale (F = GAMMA.DIST(x/b,a,1,TRUE) against the scaled CDF; G and I are densities, not identities), poisson (vs 1-GAMMA.DIST / CHISQ.DIST.RT), fdist and tdist (vs BETA.DIST), norm and lognorm (vs NORM.S.DIST / ERFC.PRECISE), expon (vs GAMMA.DIST a=1 and 1-EXP), binom (vs BETA.DIST), chisqrt (vs 1-GAMMA.DIST).
